learnPageRegisterTaxes.overview:
This registration is required to do business in New Jersey. If you don't register, you won't be able to pay your State taxes on time. This can lead to penalties and fees in addition to what you owe.

We will redirect you to the right webpage to register. After you register, save your 12-digit NJ Tax ID in your Business.NJ account. This will show you State grants, loans, and certifications you may qualify for.

#### Common taxes you may need to pay

- **Income Tax:** collected on your business's net income and profits
- **Sales and Use Tax:** paid for the sale of taxable goods and services
- **Payroll Taxes and Wage Withholding:** held on your payroll (if you have employees)
learnPageRegisterTaxes.callouts:
:::largeCallout{ showHeader="true" headerText="Application Requirements" calloutType="informational" amountIconText="" filingTypeIconText="" frequencyIconText="" phoneIconText="" phoneIconLabel="" emailIconText="" }

- EIN
- Entity ID (not required for general partnership or sole proprietorship)
- NAICS code
- NJ Business Code (we will provide you a list)
- Estimated start date
- Description of your business activity
- Estimated number of employees (if applicable)
- Anticipated first payroll withholding date for employees (if applicable)
- Information about when you expect to report and collect sales tax (if applicable)
- Owner information
- Mailing address and business location(s)
- Other taxes you may collect (for example, motor fuels and cigarette/tobacco taxes); a list will be provided

:::

:::largeCallout{ showHeader="true" headerText="Once completed, you will get this documentation:" calloutType="conditional" amountIconText="" filingTypeIconText="" frequencyIconText="" phoneIconText="" phoneIconLabel="" emailIconText="" }

- Business Registration Certificate (BRC)
- NJ Tax ID
- Business Tax PIN
- Certificate of Authority for Sales Tax (if applicable)

:::
